_comment: This is the only file you edit to add, remove or change a chain.
After editing, run:  python3 build_data.py     then commit and push.
The Framer component reads the generated JSON at runtime, so adding a chain
never requires touching Framer.
Every figure is read from the chain that issued the tokens — no aggregator.
The daily job reads each contract server-side; the page reads them again in
the visitor's browser. Both use the addresses below.
Fields:
name       display name. Must match the key in chain_logos_b64.json for the icon.
enabled    set false to stage a chain before it goes live (kept out of the page).
color      accent colour for the card's left rule and hover border.
(Supply bars are USDG green on every chain, not this colour.)
whiteBg    true if the logo is dark artwork that needs a white tile behind it.
seed       starting value, used only until the chain has been read once.
Live values live in usdg_chains.json and are written by the job.
read       how the supply is read.
kind: 'evm' | 'solana' | 'none'
evm    -> contract + decimals + rpcs (calls totalSupply)
solana -> mint + rpcs (calls getTokenSupply)
none   -> not read; the last known value is shown as-is
explorers -> optional Blockscout API roots, tried only if every
RPC fails. Same chain, one step removed.
decimals is checked against the contract on every read. If they disagree the
read is refused rather than published — a 6-vs-18 mistake would overstate a
figure by a factor of a trillion. symbol() is checked against USDG the same
way, so a wrong address fails loudly instead of showing someone else's token.
